messages.content: How can SQL injection be prevented?

SQL injection can be prevented primarily by using parameterized queries or prepared statements, which pass values separately from SQL instructions [S1]. Additionally, applications should validate inputs, use least-privilege database accounts, and avoid exposing database errors to users [S1].
